title: E-Mail-Communication - Kunde: Muster Industrie AG
description: Mockup: the e-mail communication with the customer Muster Industrie AG as conversations with summary, open points, response times, a draft reply and a flag for suspicious content.
insights: Design mockup with fictional customers and mails; no mailbox is connected and nothing is read, stored or sent.
Open points are matched with the call transcripts, for example a mail that confirms an action still open after a call.
A message that contains instructions for AI assistants is flagged and shown as plain text; replies are only ever drafts.
prompt: Bundled example: E-Mail-Communication (customer Muster Industrie AG) (static mockup, data embedded by npm run sync:mockups).
